newsitem.title: USA: Apple South to acquire Hops Grill, McCormick.
newsitem.headline: Apple South to acquire Hops Grill, McCormick.

text.p: Apple South Inc. said Friday it has agreed to acquire Hops Grill & Bar and McCormick & Schmick's restaurants for a total of $109.5 million.

Apple South said it will offer $15.75 million in cash and 1.05 million shares of its stock for Hops, a closely held company based in Clearwater, Fla., with 18 casual restaurants in Florida, Colorado and Kentucky.
Apple South, a rapidly growing restaurant holding company based in Madison, Ga., will also assume about $25 million in Hops debt.
The deal is expected to close before the end of March.

Apple South will pay $53 million for McCormick & Schmick's, which operates 16 upper-end casual seafood restaurants under the names McCormick & Schmick's, Jake's, McCormick's, McCormick & Kuleto's and Harbourside in Oregon, Washington, California, Colorado and Washington, D.C.
Sellers include Castle Harlan, Inc., a New York-based merchant bank; Bill McCormick and Doug Schmick, co-founders; and other members of management, it said.
About 90 percent of the price will be paid in cash and 10 percent in stock. Apple South said it will also assume $15 million in McCormick & Schmick's debt.

Apple South, which operates 310 casual dining restaurants, is the largest operator of Applebee's Neighbourhood Grill & Bar with 236 restaurants. The company also operates 63 Don Pablo's restaurants, 11 Harrigan's restaurants and 10 Hardee's fast-food restaurants under franchise agreements.
Apple South's stock rose 50 cents to $14.50 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
